title: Castelion careers call
description: A navy band split in two: on the left a stack of three huge bold cream phrases that light up one at a time as you scroll (the others dim to 40%), each sliding out of its mask; on the right a bold call-to-join title, a short justified paragraph and a full-width red button that flips to cream with a navy outline on hover. The right column fades up as it scrolls in.
notes: the band is bg-secondary in a dark scope
scroll-driven CSS: without support, or with reduced motion, all three phrases show at full strength
